description: Find components by what you want to build, e.g. "confirm a destructive action", "status label", "text field with validation". Ranks names, descriptions, docs, props and variant values with BM25 (local, no API key). When no component clearly matches, it says so and lists the nearest, marked `weak`. Use it when you do not know which component fits.

path.description: In a monorepo served from its root: the file you are editing, or a project folder, relative to the root, to answer from that project. Without it, every project is listed together. Ignored in a single project. When the server was started outside your project, pass the file as an absolute path: the project is found from it.

query.description: What the UI should do, in plain words.

name: search_components

package.description: At a workspace root: the package its source belongs to, e.g. "@acme/ui".

projects.description: At a workspace root: the folders of the projects that use it.

weak.description: Set when no component clearly matches the query: each result has only a word or two in common with it.

title: Search components by intent
